Can Liamani Segura, Ava Jean, Alexandro Byrd, and Kiara Romero guess each other’s special skills? From drawing to whistling and more, catch all the fun in this episode of Special Skills!

It’s a Disney Channel crossover! Stars from different Disney Channel Movie or TV shows guess each other’s “special skills” in a playful game that spotlights the actor’s hidden or unknown talents for some fun group dynamics.
